children: China's central bank said on Wednesday that it would inject up to 1 trillion yuan ($149 billion) per day via overnight reverse repos from September 28 to October 8 to meet short-term liquidity needs.
China's financial markets will be closed from October 1 until October 8 for the National Day holiday.
